summary: Ericsson filed a 6-K attaching its weekly press release on open-market share repurchases executed October 26–30, 2026. The company bought 500,000 Class B shares at a volume-weighted average of SEK 108.9180, total SEK 54.46 million, all on Nasdaq Stockholm via Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE under the EU MAR safe harbour. The purchases form part of the SEK 15 billion buyback program announced April 16, 2026, running April 23, 2026 to March 31, 2027. Treasury stock now totals 130,915,894 Class B shares; the board intends to propose cancellation at the 2027 AGM. Watch the weekly execution pace versus the program cap and treasury-share cancellation approval.
